name: AI Plan
description: What each monthly plan gives. The limits are the business team's to change here; the guides, the profiles and the reports read them on every use. Three plans, all paid, monthly only: the lowest, Seeker (now and then) and Needy (every day).

fields.label: Order
fields.description: Lowest first. The plan with the lowest order that is called Free is what everyone has until they take another.

fields.label: Tagline
fields.description: One line for the plans page.

fields.label: AI replies per month
fields.description: Every reply a guide gives counts, from any guide. When they are used the guide says so and nothing more is answered until the month starts again.

fields.label: AI replies per day
fields.description: A pace, so one day cannot use the month.

fields.label: Notes a guide reads each turn
fields.description: How much the guides remember of the person at once.

fields.label: Reports per month
fields.description: Free kundli, numerology and match reports made for the person.

fields.label: Guides allowed
fields.description: The blueprint ids of the guides this plan may talk to, separated by commas. Blank is every guide.

fields.label: What a guide says when a limit is reached
Words about the next plan
fields.description: Placeholders: {next}, {next_limit}, {next_price}. Left out when there is no higher plan.

fields.label: Cards shown with those words
fields.description: A list of cards as JSON, for example the way to a live astrologer. Each has kind, id, title, subtitle, url and button.

fields.label: No plan taken yet
fields.description: Said to a person who has not taken a plan, when plans are required. Placeholders: {plan}, {price}, {upgrade}. Used on the lowest plan.
